sections.heading: Learning Point 2
sections.content: 150 Exploring Society: India and Beyond Governance and Democracy Introduction Human beings have been living in communities for a long time.
sections.source_evidence: 150 Exploring Society: India and Beyond Governance and Democracy Introduction Human beings have been living in communities for a long time.

sections.heading: Learning Point 3
sections.content: When a large number of people live together, there can be disagreements and disorder, and rules become necessary to maintain order and harmony in the society.
sections.source_evidence: When a large number of people live together, there can be disagreements and disorder, and rules become necessary to maintain order and harmony in the society.

sections.heading: Learning Point 4
sections.content: There are probably some simple rules at home that you are expected to follow.
sections.source_evidence: There are probably some simple rules at home that you are expected to follow.

sections.heading: Learning Point 5
sections.content: The school where you study has rules too — some for students, others for teachers.
sections.source_evidence: The school where you study has rules too — some for students, others for teachers.

sections.heading: Learning Point 6
sections.content: In higher classes, students appearing for examinations must follow certain rules.
sections.source_evidence: In higher classes, students appearing for examinations must follow certain rules.

sections.heading: Learning Point 7
sections.content: Drivers on the road are expected to obey traffic rules.
sections.source_evidence: Drivers on the road are expected to obey traffic rules.

sections.heading: Learning Point 8
sections.content: People employed in all kinds of jobs also need to follow the rules set by their employer, while the employers must also follow rules which they have committed to their employees.
sections.source_evidence: People employed in all kinds of jobs also need to follow the rules set by their employer, while the employers must also follow rules which they have committed to their employees.

sections.heading: Learning Point 9
sections.content: What would happen if no one followed those rules?
sections.source_evidence: What would happen if no one followed those rules?

sections.heading: Learning Point 10
sections.content: A simple answer is that society would not be able to function.

sections.heading: Learning Point 14
sections.content: The process of taking decisions, organising the society’s life with different sets of rules, and ensuring that they are followed, is called governance.
sections.source_evidence: The process of taking decisions, organising the society’s life with different sets of rules, and ensuring that they are followed, is called governance.

sections.heading: Learning Point 15
sections.content: The group of individuals or the system that makes the rules and ensures that they are followed is called a government.
sections.source_evidence: The group of individuals or the system that makes the rules and ensures that they are followed is called a government.

sections.heading: Learning Point 16
sections.content: Some of the more important rules are called laws.

sections.heading: Learning Point 17
sections.content: This does not mean that rules and laws are set once and for all.
